- Explore a local audio library: import clips or a whole folder of sounds and see which ones sound alike on the map ([#81](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/81), [#86](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/86), [#137](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/137)).
- Music mode shows BPM, key with Camelot notation, estimated genre and energy, and the closest tracks with reasons ([#88](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/88), [#128](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/128), [#151](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/151)).
- Mix points find intros, drops, breakdowns and outros ([#135](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/135)), and "Mix with" is fast on large libraries ([#126](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/126)).
- Duplicates and remixes are grouped together as versions ([#130](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/130)).
- Export BPM, key and sound tags to Rekordbox ([#127](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/127)).
- Built-in sound tagger for instruments and DJ sounds ([#129](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/129)), trained on SoundCloud tracks, DJ effect clips and FSD50K labels ([#141](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/141), [#195](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/195)), with short-clip one-shot detectors and more DJ heads ([#91](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/91), [#94](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/94), [#108](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/108), [#110](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/110)).
- The tagger now covers dozens more tags, including kalimba, djembe, hand and tuned percussion, bell, bass guitar, hi-hat, crash cymbal, whisper, voice, kick, clap, organ, gong, laser, riser, conga, acid synth, synth lead, vocoder vocal, record stop, glitch effect, choir, rimshot and staccato ([#188](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/188), [#199](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/199), [#206](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/206), [#207](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/207), [#208](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/208), [#234](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/234), [#236](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/236), [#241](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/241), [#242](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/242), [#244](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/244), [#245](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/245), [#246](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/246), [#248](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/248), [#258](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/258), [#262](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/262), [#267](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/267)).
- Clave, drum fill, spoken phrase, tom and vocal laugh are now tagged on short clips too ([#251](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/251)).
- Descriptive sound words such as warm, airy and metallic, from measured sound rules ([#189](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/189)).
- Sound-alike links are explained by shared tags and picked by fingerprint plus music style; generic tags no longer link tracks on their own ([#103](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/103), [#112](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/112), [#115](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/115), [#165](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/165)).
- New filters: detected sound ([#157](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/157)), Loop or one-shot ([#219](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/219)), Part (drums, bass, vocals or melody) ([#220](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/220)), and several file types at once ([#176](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/176)).
- Faster library work: unchanged files are skipped when a folder is re-read ([#144](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/144)), only newly added sounds are analyzed ([#192](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/192)), and audio processing is faster overall ([#164](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/164), [#168](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/168)).
- Smarter audio model downloads: models preload when the app opens ([#118](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/118)) but are skipped for people who don't use audio ([#131](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/131)), and phones and data saver keep the small instrument model ([#182](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/182)).
- Simpler clip panel and first-run screens, with the welcome screen leading with audio ([#170](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/170), [#173](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/173)).
- Ingest 100+ document and code formats ([#29](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/29)).
- Side-by-side document comparison ([#72](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/72)).
- Chat across all your documents, not just the top 8 passages ([#76](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/76)).
- Search, chat and similar documents are connected to the reader ([#38](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/38)), insights are connected to search and chat ([#39](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/39)), and insights rank hubs and show cluster stats ([#14](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/14)).
- More accurate links and search: path/symbol mentions, wikilinks and test↔source pairs ([#18](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/18)), better link and match accuracy ([#96](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/96)), and spelling variants like Postgres/PostgreSQL merged ([#122](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/122)). Search now says "no match" for off-topic queries ([#93](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/93)).
- Larger graphs: the 4,096-node cap is gone and PDF parsing moved off the main thread ([#78](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/78)).
- Live collaboration sessions with follow mode ([#26](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/26), [#28](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/28)).
- Better 2D map: drag to pan, a toolbar toggle and a remembered mode ([#57](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/57), [#67](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/67), [#68](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/68), [#69](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/69)).
- Reader-first side panel ([#70](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/70)), a wider reader with path glow ([#60](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/60)), a fly-in animation as documents load ([#59](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/59), [#71](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/71)), and the code language shown on selected documents ([#23](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/23)).
- A slimmer default layout focused on the core document-graph loop ([#19](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/19)), plus UI polish for search failures, demo-load feedback and accessibility labels ([#13](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/13), [#53](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/53), [#79](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/79)).
- Visual cleanup of the welcome screen, graph workspace, side panels and dialogs: consistent buttons, readable 13–14px labels and text that meets contrast requirements ([#263](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/263), [#265](https://github.com/chrisatom1998/document-graph-explorer/pull/265)).
